authorization: User: continue and complete next phase also, after starting Phase 7. Complete local operational work, then a separately frozen held-out comparison under these ceilings. No purchases, resets, new keys or unrestricted host permissions.
scope_refinement: One repetition initially: 18 tasks x A/B = 36 reserved task attempts. The plan allows a second repetition when affordable; defer it before observing any held-out outcome because the development block exhausted quota after one valid pair. This is a small pilot, not 18 independent families or a broad performance benchmark. Do not automatically launch another block after quota resets.

conditions.A: Existing host, original pre-fix guidance, controlled state and runtime dependencies
conditions.B: Identical host/setup plus ctx_context/ctx_expand and the fixed usage instruction. Lexical v2; notes/neighbors off. ctx_check excluded through the host tool allowlist.

order: Task order remains manifest order, one A/B pair per task, alternating first arm by task index. Preserve within-split family clusters. Reserve append-only ledger before each model invocation.
stop_rule: Stop entire block immediately on infrastructure/authentication/quota failure. Preserve every attempt; never retry a task to improve its outcome. Task failure, valid timeout or ignored tool remains an eligible outcome. Incomplete assessments require honest unassessed labels, not automatic success.
readiness: Require verified frozen product/task/assessment hashes, 18 fail-before/pass-after assessments, a fresh static sandbox/config report and one matching real MCP/filesystem capability probe. Check protected project, personal state and peer denials before each task; clean up owned sandbox deny state in finally.
assessment: Protected pre-fix source export with only production edits overlaid, original tests restored, runtime dependencies identical in both arms. Focused hidden behavioral regression plus declared pre-existing behavior controls and patch review. Original upstream selected tests where qualified; full upstream lint/types/coverage suites are not promised. Review task requirements beyond the focused test. Agent-edited tests cannot replace protected checks.
limitations: Public historical tasks may be known to the model
Legacy dependency graphs use recorded compatible resolved locks where upstream locks cannot install; not the exact original historical environment
Assessment author is the implementation agent, independent of treatment outcomes but not a blinded independent human reviewer
No uniform full upstream regression suite; focused acceptance plus control tests and patch review limits general correctness claims
Windows sandbox allows root reads with explicit protected denials and permits loopback; known assessment isolation, not a malicious-host security proof
usage: Reported input/output/cache fields, command/tool timing and default non-use remain in the primary comparison. Cached input is a subset. Missing usage/compaction/prices remain unavailable. Tool-invoked subgroup is descriptive and noncausal.
optional_improvement: At most one later development-only experiment if a dominant failure and budget justify it. No held-out tuning; further improvements may be explicitly deferred.
